newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures rally on good buying interest.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures rally on good buying interest.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures rallied in late trading on Wednesday with good buying interest seen in the market, brokers said.
The market also saw support from the bullish American Petrolem Institute (API) crude stocks figures, they said.
The prompt January contract last traded at the day's high of $23.50, up 12 cents from its last close on London's International Petroleum Exchange, with 222 lots traded at 0953 GMT.
February was quoted at $23.00/$23.05 against its last close at $22.92.
Brokers said they see prompt month resistance at between $23.75.
The API stocks figures showed a drop of 3.5 million barrels in crude oil stocks, distillate stocks rose by 920,000 barrels and gasoline down by 535,000 barrels.
The after-hours ACCESS system last traded at $24.63, up 14 cents from its last NYMEX close, while January was last traded at $24.25, five cents over its previous close.
